sources.name: MarkTechPost
sources.summary: In this tutorial, we build a workflow that uses Docling Parse to analyze PDF documents at a detailed structural level. We prepare a stable Python environment, handle common Colab dependency issues, and generate a custom multi-page PDF with text, columns, table-like content, vector shapes, and an embedded image. We then extract words, characters, and lines with page-level coordinates, render visual overlays, and save results into structured JSON and CSV. We see how low-level parsing supports layout analysis, reading-order reconstruction, and retrieval-ready document preparation. The post How to Build a Parsing Pipeline with Docling Parse for Layout-Aware Document Intelligence appeared first on MarkTechPost .
